extraction_method: Offline FastMCP list_tools on AST-selected registration declarations: original model classes, type aliases, decorator arguments, function signatures and return annotations preserved; function bodies replaced with pass solely to avoid provider imports, credentials, lifespans and remote calls. Actual implementations inspected separately.
limitations: Community and hosted are separate server surfaces, not one merged deployment. No live provider calls were made. Installed current compatible FastMCP/Pydantic versions for schema generation rather than full project lock environment.
reason: All 22 registered tools across both distinct surfaces have complete locally generated input schemas and public implementations.

tools.name: get_news_by_keyword
tools.description: Find recent Google News articles for a free-form keyword or phrase. Use this for ad-hoc subject searches; use get_news_by_topic for a predefined topic category or get_news_by_site for one publisher.

period.description: Number of days to look back for articles.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

full_data.description: Return full data for each article. If False a summary should be created by setting the summarize flag

summarize.description: Generate a summary of the article, will first try LLM Sampling but if unavailable will use nlp

tools.behavior: Searches Google News by keyword, downloads/parses articles, optionally summarizes with MCP sampling or local NLP.

tools.name: get_news_by_location
tools.description: Find recent Google News articles about a place-focused location such as a city, state, or country. Use this when geography is the primary filter; use get_news_by_keyword for general subject searches.

period.description: Number of days to look back for articles.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

full_data.description: Return full data for each article. If False a summary should be created by setting the summarize flag

summarize.description: Generate a summary of the article, will first try LLM Sampling but if unavailable will use nlp

tools.behavior: Searches Google News location coverage, parses articles and optionally summarizes them.

tools.name: get_news_by_topic
tools.description: Find recent Google News articles from a predefined Google News topic category. Use this for topic category browsing such as BUSINESS, TECHNOLOGY, or SPORTS; use get_news_by_keyword for a free-form query.

period.description: Number of days to look back for articles.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

full_data.description: Return full data for each article. If False a summary should be created by setting the summarize flag

summarize.description: Generate a summary of the article, will first try LLM Sampling but if unavailable will use nlp

tools.behavior: Searches a predefined Google News topic, parses articles and optionally summarizes them.

tools.name: get_top_news
tools.description: Return general headline and top-news stories from Google News without a keyword or topic seed. Use this for a broad news snapshot; use the keyword, location, topic, or site tools when the user gives a filter.

period.description: Number of days to look back for top articles.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

full_data.description: Return full data for each article. If False a summary should be created by setting the summarize flag

summarize.description: Generate a summary of the article, will first try LLM Sampling but if unavailable will use nlp

tools.behavior: Fetches Google News headlines, parses articles and optionally summarizes them.

tools.name: get_trending_terms
tools.description: Return terms that are trending now for a geography, optionally with related news metadata. Use this for current trend discovery; use get_trends when the user wants historical interest over time for known keywords.

geo.description:
Geographic target for trending terms. Supports four levels of granularity:
- Worldwide: empty string ''
- Country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. 'US', 'GB', 'CA'
- Subdivision (state/province/region): ISO 3166-2 format 'CC-XX' or 'CC-XXX', e.g. 'US-CA' (California), 'BE-BRU' (Brussels)
- US metro area: bare Nielsen DMA code (numeric string), e.g. '807' (San Francisco Bay Area), '501' (New York City)

full_data.description: Return full data for each trend including related news stories.

tools.behavior: Fetches Google Trends Trending Now RSS, sorts terms by parsed approximate volume; optionally includes news metadata.

tools.name: get_trends
tools.description: Return historical Google Trends interest-over-time points for one or more known keywords. Use this for trajectory and comparisons across a timeframe; values are normalized 0-100 interest scores, not absolute search volume. Use get_trending_terms for what is trending now.

keyword.description: Search keyword(s) to analyze; comparison lists support 1-5 keywords.

data_mode.description: Legacy resolution hint used only when timeframe is omitted.

timeframe.description: Explicit TrendsPy range, for example 'today 12-m', 'today 90-d', 'all', or 'YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD'. Overrides data_mode when supplied.

cat.description: Google Trends category ID; use 0 for all categories or a value from get_categories.

tools.behavior: Fetches TrendsPy interest_over_time; removes incomplete points and returns date/value/keyword rows.
validation_notes: Implementation strips keyword whitespace, rejects empty terms and duplicate normalized keywords, and requires 1-5 comparison keywords; hosted comparison schema requires 2-5. These normalization/uniqueness checks are not encoded as uniqueItems in the input schema.
Omitted/null timeframe maps weekly to today 5-y, daily to today 3-m, monthly to all; explicit timeframe passes through to TrendsPy.

tools.name: get_growth
tools.description: Estimate momentum for one or more known keywords across requested growth windows. Use this when percentage growth is the goal; use get_trends when the user needs the underlying historical time series.

keyword.description: Search keyword(s) to analyze; comparison lists support 1-5 keywords.

tools.behavior: Fetches a sufficiently long TrendsPy time series and computes average-interest percentage changes for requested windows; zero baseline returns null.
validation_notes: Implementation strips keyword whitespace, rejects empty terms and duplicate normalized keywords, and requires 1-5 comparison keywords; hosted comparison schema requires 2-5. These normalization/uniqueness checks are not encoded as uniqueItems in the input schema.
Null percent_growth becomes [3M,1Y]. Each supplied string is trimmed/uppercased and must match positive integer plus D/W/M/Y; this pattern is implementation validation, not an input-schema pattern.

tools.name: get_ranked_trends
tools.description: Return currently trending keywords ranked by week-over-week growth or volume. Use this when explicit ranked order matters; use get_top_trends for a simpler current feed and get_trends for historical series.

limit.description: Maximum number of trends to return.

tools.behavior: Fetches 24-hour Trending Now feed and sorts by provider volume_growth_pct or volume; includes news.
validation_notes: wow_pct_change naming/description does not compute a separate weekly baseline here; it sorts the current provider volume_growth_pct from a 24-hour feed.

tools.name: get_top_trends
tools.description: Return a bounded current topic discovery feed from Google Trends RSS, including related news where available. Use this for current top or daily trends; use get_ranked_trends when explicit ranking by growth or volume matters.

limit.description: Maximum number of trends to return.

tools.behavior: Google Trends selects Trending Now RSS; Daily Trends selects 24-hour Trending Now; truncates feed and includes news.
validation_notes: Registered description mentions top or daily RSS; actual Daily Trends implementation calls trending_now(hours=24), whereas Google Trends calls trending_now_by_rss.

tools.name: get_news_by_site
tools.description: Find recent Google News articles from one publisher domain. Use this when the user wants source-specific coverage; use get_news_by_keyword for cross-publisher subject search.

site.description: Domain of the news site, e.g. 'cnn.com'.

period.description: Number of days to look back for articles.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

full_data.description: Return full data for each article. If False a summary should be created by setting the summarize flag

summarize.description: Generate a summary of the article, will first try LLM Sampling but if unavailable will use nlp

tools.behavior: Searches Google News for a publisher domain, parses articles and optionally summarizes them.

tools.name: get_article_content
tools.description: Download and parse one specific news article when you already have an article URL. Use it to retrieve article text or metadata or summarize that URL; do not use it for discovery - use the news search tools instead.

url.description: The URL of the news article to download and parse.

full_data.description: Return full data for the article. If False a summary should be created by setting the summarize flag

summarize.description: Generate a summary of the article, will first try LLM Sampling but if unavailable will use nlp

tools.behavior: Validates HTTP(S) URL and safe public targets, downloads/parses a specific article, optionally summarizes; returns null if unavailable.
validation_notes: Schema URL is an unrestricted string. Implementation rejects whitespace/control characters, non-HTTP(S), missing host, embedded credentials and invalid ports; downloader separately rejects nonpublic addresses and unsafe redirects.

tools.name: get_interest_by_region
tools.description: Return geographic Google Trends interest for one or more known keywords at country, region, city, or DMA resolution. Use this to compare where demand is strongest; use get_trends for interest over time instead.

geo.description: Geographic region code (e.g. 'US' or empty '' for worldwide).

inc_low_vol.description: Include regions with low search volume.

tools.behavior: Fetches TrendsPy interest_by_region and returns names/codes/coordinates plus per-keyword interest.
validation_notes: Implementation strips keyword whitespace, rejects empty terms and duplicate normalized keywords, and requires 1-5 comparison keywords; hosted comparison schema requires 2-5. These normalization/uniqueness checks are not encoded as uniqueItems in the input schema.

tools.name: get_related_queries
tools.description: Return top and rising literal search queries related to one seed keyword. Use this for query expansion; use get_related_topics for topic entities or get_suggestions for autocomplete candidates.
tools.behavior: Fetches top/rising TrendsPy queries for one seed, with unavailable-response retry.
validation_notes: Implementation trims the seed and rejects whitespace-only input through provider validation, in addition to registered string constraints.

tools.name: get_related_topics
tools.description: Return top and rising Google Trends topic entities related to one seed keyword. Use this for entity or topic expansion; use get_related_queries for literal search queries.
tools.behavior: Fetches top/rising TrendsPy topic entities for one seed.
validation_notes: Implementation trims the seed and rejects whitespace-only input through provider validation, in addition to registered string constraints.

tools.name: get_suggestions
tools.description: Return Google Trends autocomplete suggestions for a seed keyword. Use this for lightweight autocomplete or entity candidates; use get_related_queries when you need top or rising demand signals.
tools.behavior: Fetches TrendsPy autocomplete entity suggestions.
validation_notes: Implementation trims the seed and rejects whitespace-only input through provider validation, in addition to registered string constraints.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: Return a bounded page of Google Trends category IDs and names for use in the cat parameter of trend tools. Use query to find categories by name and offset/limit to page through broader results; do not guess category IDs.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match against category names.

limit.description: Maximum categories to return in this page.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the filtered category list.

tools.behavior: Fetches Google Trends categories, filters category names case-insensitively by substring and applies offset/limit.

tools.name: discover_trends
tools.description: Discover broad, currently trending search topics in a geographic market. Use this when the user has no specific seed keyword yet and wants emerging topics ranked by growth or volume.

geo.description: Geographic market, typically an ISO country code such as US, GB, or DE.

sort_by.description: Rank by recent growth or current trend volume.

tools.behavior: Calls ranked Trending Now discovery, maps growth/volume sort and includes at most three news snippets per trend.
tools.availability: Separate remote HTTP facade mcp_trendpulse.hosted:hosted_mcp; selected by asgi.create_app, authenticated according to remote auth configuration

tools.name: analyze_keyword_trend
tools.description: Analyze one known keyword's Google Trends trajectory. Use this for direction, recent/average/peak normalized interest, growth windows, and a bounded time series; do not use it to compare multiple keywords.

keyword.description: Single keyword or topic phrase to analyze.

geo.description: Geographic market such as US or GB.

timeframe.description: Google Trends window such as 'today 12-m', 'today 90-d', 'today 5-y', or an exact date range.

max_points.description: Maximum time-series points returned after deterministic downsampling.

tools.behavior: Fetches one term time series and separate 3M/1Y growth; returns latest/average/peak metrics and deterministically downsampled series.
validation_notes: Implementation trims the seed and rejects whitespace-only input through provider validation, in addition to registered string constraints.
tools.availability: Separate remote HTTP facade mcp_trendpulse.hosted:hosted_mcp; selected by asgi.create_app, authenticated according to remote auth configuration

tools.name: compare_keyword_trends
tools.description: Compare 2-5 known keywords on the same Google Trends scale and window. Use this when relative momentum between alternatives matters; use analyze_keyword_trend for only one keyword.

keywords.description: Two to five unique keywords to compare on one normalized Trends request.

geo.description: Geographic market such as US or GB.

timeframe.description: Google Trends window shared by all keywords.

max_points_per_keyword.description: Maximum returned points for each keyword.

tools.behavior: Normalizes and validates 2-5 terms, fetches a shared normalized time series and 3M/1Y growth, returns bounded series and metrics per term.
validation_notes: Implementation strips keyword whitespace, rejects empty terms and duplicate normalized keywords, and requires 1-5 comparison keywords; hosted comparison schema requires 2-5. These normalization/uniqueness checks are not encoded as uniqueItems in the input schema.
tools.availability: Separate remote HTTP facade mcp_trendpulse.hosted:hosted_mcp; selected by asgi.create_app, authenticated according to remote auth configuration

tools.name: discover_related_demand
tools.description: Expand one seed keyword into related search demand. Use this for top/rising queries, related topics, and entity suggestions; it does not return a time-series analysis.

geo.description: Geographic market such as US or GB.

source.description: Google Trends search property used for related-demand data.

limit.description: Maximum items returned in each related-demand section.

tools.behavior: Combines top/rising related queries, topics and autocomplete suggestions, bounding each section by limit.
validation_notes: Implementation trims the seed and rejects whitespace-only input through provider validation, in addition to registered string constraints.
tools.availability: Separate remote HTTP facade mcp_trendpulse.hosted:hosted_mcp; selected by asgi.create_app, authenticated according to remote auth configuration

tools.name: get_trend_context
tools.description: Add current-news context to one keyword and return a compact recent trend snapshot. Use this when the user asks why a term may be moving now or wants sources to investigate; use analyze_keyword_trend for trend metrics without news.

geo.description: Geographic market for the trend snapshot.

news_period_days.description: How many recent days of news to inspect.

tools.behavior: Combines a fixed today 90-d Google Search trend snapshot with recent keyword news links; geo filters trends but does not independently filter news.
validation_notes: Implementation trims the seed and rejects whitespace-only input through provider validation, in addition to registered string constraints.
tools.availability: Separate remote HTTP facade mcp_trendpulse.hosted:hosted_mcp; selected by asgi.create_app, authenticated according to remote auth configuration

tools.name: find_seo_opportunities
tools.description: Find trend-driven SEO keyword candidates from one seed. Use this for rising related queries that are checked against current Google Trends interest. If project_id is supplied, annotate candidates with exact-query Search Console metrics for that authenticated DigestSEO project; without it results remain trend-only. Do not treat either signal as absolute search volume.

seed_keyword.description: Seed keyword defining the SEO topic space.

geo.description: Geographic market such as US or GB.

timeframe.description: Window used for related demand and trend validation.

limit.description: Maximum validated opportunity candidates. Google Trends comparisons are capped at five keywords.

project_id.description: Optional DigestSEO Site Audit project ID owned by the authenticated account. Enables a 28-day exact-query Search Console validation pass.

tools.behavior: Selects rising related queries first, then top queries, skips empty/duplicate/seed terms and fetches shared candidate interest. Optional project_id adds 28-day exact-query DigestSEO Search Console metrics.
validation_notes: Implementation trims the seed and rejects whitespace-only input through provider validation, in addition to registered string constraints.
project_id is nullable but constrained when provided; credentials/auth context are internal, not caller input. Optional DigestSEO failures may be represented as unavailable project context.
tools.availability: Separate remote HTTP facade mcp_trendpulse.hosted:hosted_mcp; selected by asgi.create_app, authenticated according to remote auth configuration
